key_insight: Simultaneously accounting for nonlinear energy and cross-helicity transfer uniquely determines pair exchanges within incompressible MHD triad interactions.
engineering_relevance: This result could support less ambiguous interpretation of energy-transfer pathways in incompressible MHD simulations.
method: Analyze conservative nonlinear exchanges among three spatial fluctuations.
Constrain triad dynamics using simultaneous cross-helicity transfer.
Prove uniqueness of the resulting pair-exchange representation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a mathematical uniqueness proof, not numerical benchmarks or experimental validation.
watch_item: The result applies to incompressible MHD; extension to compressible flows or Navier–Stokes turbulence is not established in the abstract.
